name: Integration for Epos Now and WooCommerce
author: Slynk Digital

sections.description:
Keep your Epos Now store and WooCommerce website working from the same product, stock, customer and order information. Slynk helps reduce duplicate data entry, keep online availability accurate and route ecommerce orders into your retail or hospitality workflow.

This is the companion plugin for Slynk’s paid Epos Now and WooCommerce integration service. A rolling monthly subscription is required. Guided onboarding, training, Epos Now API access and direct support are included.

See how the integration works | Pricing | Documentation

What stays in sync

  • Stock: keep online availability accurate and reduce the risk of selling items that are no longer in stock.
  • Products: update product information once instead of maintaining the same details in two places.
  • Orders and refunds: sync orders and refunds with support for till notifications, printing and kitchen display workflows where configured.
  • Customers: send customer details with online orders and reduce manual entry for your team.
  • Visibility: monitor connected products, orders and recent activity from the Slynk dashboard.

Choose your master platform

Choose whether your team maintains product information and stock levels in Epos Now or WooCommerce. You can choose a different master for products and stock, so each change is made once in the platform that best suits your business. If you have more than one Epos Now location, you can also choose which locations supply stock to your website.

Connect an existing catalogue

Already selling in both systems? Product Linker helps match existing items by SKU, barcode or name, so you can connect your catalogue without rebuilding it from scratch. You review the suggested matches before anything goes live.

Supports the products you sell

The integration supports simple and variable products, measured products and Epos Now master-and-child products. It is also compatible with the official WooCommerce Product Bundles, Mix and Match Products and Composite Products extensions.

Managed by Slynk

Slynk runs and maintains the integration for you, so you do not need to host or manage a separate connection between the platforms. Your subscription includes ongoing compatibility updates and direct support, with no per-order fee and no long-term contract.

Introduction

Full walkthrough

External Service

This plugin connects to Slynk’s managed integration service. It cannot synchronise Epos Now and WooCommerce by itself.

After you subscribe, connect your accounts and enable synchronisation, the plugin sends configuration information and the WooCommerce product, stock, order, refund and customer data required by your enabled syncs. Slynk processes that data, communicates with Epos Now, and stores operational settings, product mappings and diagnostics needed to provide and support the integration. The exact data transferred depends on the sync directions and features you enable.

Use of the service is subject to Slynk’s Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions.
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • HTTPS on your WooCommerce site
  • A WordPress account with Shop Manager or Administrator access
  • An active Slynk Epos Now and WooCommerce integration subscription

Setup

  1. Start your Slynk subscription.
  2. Install and activate this plugin from Plugins > Add New in WordPress.
  3. Follow the guided onboarding to connect Epos Now and WooCommerce.
  4. Choose your product and stock masters, locations and sync options.
  5. Link existing products and enable the syncs.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Slynk subscription?

Yes. This plugin connects WooCommerce to Slynk’s paid managed integration service and does not provide standalone synchronisation. The service is billed monthly and includes onboarding, Epos Now API access, training and support. View current pricing.

Can Epos Now or WooCommerce be my master platform?

Yes. Choose the platform where your team will maintain product information and stock. They do not have to be the same; for example, you can manage product details in WooCommerce while Epos Now controls stock.

How quickly are changes synchronised?

Most changes are sent within minutes. Occasional delays can happen if either platform is busy or temporarily unavailable.

Can I connect products that already exist in both systems?

Yes. Product Linker can suggest matches using SKU, barcode and name, and lets you review or create links manually.

Can I use more than one Epos Now location?

Yes. Choose which Epos Now shops or locations should supply stock to your website. You can combine availability from selected locations to suit the way you fulfil online orders.

Are orders, refunds and customers supported?

Yes. WooCommerce orders and customer details can be sent to Epos Now. Refunds are supported and are configured during onboarding to match the way your team works.

Which product types are supported?

Common setups include simple and variable products, multipacks, measured products and Epos Now master-and-child products. The official WooCommerce Product Bundles, Mix and Match Products and Composite Products extensions are also compatible. We confirm unusual catalogue structures during onboarding.

Are product images synchronised?

No. Product images are not currently synchronised between Epos Now and WooCommerce.

Can I connect multiple WooCommerce websites?

Yes, but each WooCommerce website requires its own integration subscription and configuration.

When is support available?

Direct support is available from 9am to 5pm UK time on working days. See the documentation for setup and troubleshooting guidance.
